name: gemini-exporter
description: 100% Free & open-source • 100% local, no tracking • One-click export all chats • PDF, HTML & Markdown • Hands-off background export

scripts.lint: oxlint -A all -W typescript/no-explicit-any -W typescript/no-unsafe-assignment -W typescript/no-unsafe-argument -W typescript/no-unsafe-call -W typescript/no-unsafe-member-access -W typescript/no-unsafe-return -W typescript/no-unsafe-type-assertion -D typescript/no-floating-promises --type-aware src/
scripts.test: node scripts/check-zero-any.cjs && npm run type-check && npm run test:unit && node build.js && playwright test

author: Wenbo Cui
